text:
marta: Quick sync 1 microburst credit push for next week. Goal: boost first-5-requests CVR by 15% and get +200 webinar signups. Thoughts on creative, routing, and easy tracking?

sam: Two-lane idea: credit-first CTA for brand-new signups; webinar-first for engaged trial users (opened docs or hit quickstarts). A/B test headline + prompt-template incentive.

jin: Creative variants (keep tiny):
1) "Starter tokens: 5 free requests" with product UI hero
2) "Live demo + 5 free requests" with person-on-laptop hero
3) "Prompt pack + 5 tokens" with code snippet hero
Each should have a small badge "No CC" and token count up front.

ara: Routing rules: new_signups -> credit-first; trial_openers (docs_open >1) -> webinar-first. Weighted rollout 70/30 for first 48h then 50/50. Add debounce so a user sees only one CTA within 24h.

marta: Metrics: first-5-requests CVR (primary), 7-day retention (used >50 tokens), webinar reg & attend. Success = +15% CVR OR 200 incremental active users in 7 days.

sam: Quick copy options (short, for subject/hero):
A) "Try Redwood 1 5 free requests to get started"
B) "Get 5 free requests + a live demo"
C) "Starter prompt pack + 5 tokens 1 instant results"
Use them across email subject, hero, and doc banner.

jin: Design notes: show token count and a tiny perf stat ("dev latency <100ms") to appeal to devs. Provide mobile crops. Hero C should include prompt pack thumbnail.

ara: Ops checklist:
- Deploy landing variants under /microburst-credits?burst=1
- Configure Launchboard segments and flags: experiment 'microburst_071'
- Events to track: page_view, started_requests, webinar_reg, webinar_attend, token_usage
- Ensure debounce so same user not double-targeted

launch-bot: Experiment flag 'microburst_071' created. Staging push scheduled for 2024-07-22T09:00Z.

marta: Timeline: assets by EOD Wed. Assignments: jin -> hero images (3), sam -> copy + email drafts, ara -> routing & tracking wiring.

jin: Will mock images today and upload to Figma https://figma.com/file/microburst-credits (placeholder). Including 2x mobile crops.

sam: I'll draft the email, 3 subjects, two social variants, and the doc banner. Sharing by tomorrow AM.

ara: I'll add routing rules in Launchboard and connect metrics dashboard. Will confirm event names and make sure analytics team has access.

marta: Experiment config proposal:
- N: 20k impressions first 72h
- Split: 50/50 credit vs webinar in eligible pool; within each lane run subject-line A/B
- Win: +15% CVR at p<0.05 OR 200 incremental actives within 7d
- Rollback: if infra error rate >1.5% or latency spike, revert to baseline landing

sam: Add one CTA variant that includes a 3-prompt "build a dev sandbox" template set. That should help retention signals.

jin: Will add prompt pack screenshot to hero C and include callout text for the 3 starter prompts.

marta: Final ask: drop assets + copy by tomorrow noon so QA and staging push can happen. Tag me if blocked. :rocket:
